newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil railway concession fetches 15.8 mln reais.
newsitem.headline: Brazil railway concession fetches 15.8 mln reais.

text.p: A consortium led by Brazilian steelmaker CSN and the privatised mining concern CVRD bought a 30-year concession to operate the Northeast railway, a Rio de Janeiro bourse official said.
The concession was purchased for 15.8 million reais, about 38 percent more than the minimum price of 11.5 million reais set for the auction.

The 2,924.4-mile (4,679 km) Northeast section links the northeastern states of Maranhao, Piaui, Ceara, Rio Grande do Norte, Paraiba, Pernambuco, Alagoas and Sergipe. It joins with the Center-East rail section.

The sale of the concession to the group led by CSN, or Companhia Siderurgica Nacional SA, and CVRD, or Companhia Vale do Rio Doce SA, completes the privatization of Brazil's federal railway network, which began in March 1996.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151))
